

# meta data for processing

### 1. Bulk-RNAseq or SmartSeq2

| Column | Description |
|:---:|:---|
| BaseDir | data base dir |
| BatchID | analysis batch id |
| SeqPlatform | sequencing platform : BulkRNAseq, SmartSeq2 |
| SeqID | sample id ( gcx-id ) |
| GenomeAssembly | reference genome version |
| IndivID | individual ID (required) |

### 2. scRNAseq

| Column | Description |
|:---:|:---|
| BaseDir | data base dir |
| BatchID | analysis batch id |
| SeqPlatform | sequencing platform : scRNAseq |
| SeqBatchID | sequencing batch id |
| GenomeAssembly | reference genome version |
| IndivID | individual ID (optional) |
